bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'STARTLESS_UNCERTAIN_POLICY_READONLY\n'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT m.chat_id,m.message_id,p.message_thread_id,LEFT(p.title,40),CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_topics t WHERE t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND t.purpose='link') THEN 'BLOCK_LINK_TOPIC' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM board_menu_panels b WHERE b.chat_id=p.chat_id AND b.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND b.panel_type='general_guide') THEN 'BLOCK_GUIDE' WHEN p.title ILIKE '%総合案内%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニテーリング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%相互リング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%ﾘﾝｸ%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニティリンク%' THEN 'BLOCK_TITLE' ELSE 'NOT_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY' END FROM startless_public_post_migrations m JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=m.chat_id AND p.message_id=m.message_id WHERE m.state='uncertain' ORDER BY m.chat_id,m.message_id;"
printf 'APPLIED_COUNT='; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='applied';"
echo NO_MODIFICATION=TRUE
